056        public SystemBountyIntel(MarketAPI market) {
057                this(market, -1, false);
058        }
059        public SystemBountyIntel(MarketAPI market, int baseReward, boolean commerceMode) {
060                this.market = market;
061                this.commerceMode = commerceMode;
062                
063                location = market.getContainingLocation();
064                faction = market.getFaction();
065                if (commerceMode) {
066                        faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
067                }
068                
069                if (!commerceMode && market.getFaction().isPlayerFaction()) {
070                        endImmediately();
071                        return;
072                }
073                
074                baseBounty = Global.getSettings().getFloat("baseSystemBounty");
075                float marketSize = market.getSize();
076                
077                baseBounty *= (marketSize + 5f) / 10f;
078                
079                //float lowStabilityMult = BaseMarketConditionPlugin.getLowStabilityPenaltyMult(market);
080                float highStabilityMult = BaseMarketConditionPlugin.getHighStabilityBonusMult(market);
081                highStabilityMult = 1f + (highStabilityMult - 1f) * 0.5f;
082                
083                //baseBounty *= lowStabilityMult;
084                baseBounty *= highStabilityMult;
085                
086                baseBounty = (int) baseBounty;
087                if (baseReward > 0) {
088                        baseBounty = baseReward;
089                }
090                
091                log.info(String.format("Starting bounty at market [%s], %d credits per frigate", market.getName(), (int) baseBounty));
092                
093                updateLikelyCauseFaction();
094                
095                
096                //conditionToken = market.addCondition(Conditions.EVENT_SYSTEM_BOUNTY, this);
097                
098                if (commerceMode) {
099                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(this);
100                } else {
101                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().queueIntel(this);
102                }
103                
104                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().addListener(this);
105                
106                if (!commerceMode) {
107                        MilitaryResponseParams params = new MilitaryResponseParams(ActionType.HOSTILE, 
108                                        "system_bounty_" + market.getId(), 
109                                        getFactionForUIColors(),
110                                        market.getPrimaryEntity(),
111                                        0.75f,
112                                        duration);
113                        script = new MilitaryResponseScript(params);
114                        location.addScript(script);
115                }
116        }
117        
118        public void reportMadeVisibleToPlayer() {
119                if (!isEnding() && !isEnded()) {
120                        duration = Math.max(duration * 0.5f, Math.min(duration * 2f, MAX_DURATION));
121                }
122        }

150        private void updateLikelyCauseFaction() {
151                int maxSize = 0;
152                MarketAPI maxOther = null;
153                for (MarketAPI other : Misc.getNearbyMarkets(market.getLocationInHyperspace(), 0f)) {
154                        if (market.getFaction() == other.getFaction()) continue;
155                        if (!market.getFaction().isHostileTo(other.getFaction())) continue;
156                        
157                        int size = other.getSize();
158                        if (size > maxSize) {
159                                maxSize = size;
160                                maxOther = other;
161                        }
162                }
163                
164                if (maxOther != null) {
165                        enemyFaction = maxOther.getFaction();
166                } else {
167                        enemyFaction = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
168                }
169                
170        }
171        
172        @Override
173        protected void advanceImpl(float amount) {
174                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
175                
176                elapsedDays += days;
177
178                if (elapsedDays >= duration && !isDone() && !commerceMode) {
179                        endAfterDelay();
180                        boolean current = market.getContainingLocation() == Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation();
181                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(new Object(), !current);
182                        return;
183                }
184                if (faction != market.getFaction() || !market.isInEconomy()) {
185                        endAfterDelay();
186                        boolean current = market.getContainingLocation() == Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation();
187                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(new Object(), !current);
188                        return;
189                }
190        }
191        
192        public float getTimeRemainingFraction() {
193                if (commerceMode) return 1f;
194                float f = 1f - elapsedDays / duration;
195                return f;
196        }

215                public float fraction;
216                public ReputationAdjustmentResult rep;

228        public void reportBattleOccurred(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle) {
229                if (isEnded() || isEnding()) return;
230                
231                if (!battle.isPlayerInvolved()) return;
232                
233                if (!Misc.isNear(primaryWinner, market.getLocationInHyperspace())) return;
234                
235                int payment = 0;
236                float fpDestroyed = 0;
237                for (CampaignFleetAPI otherFleet : battle.getNonPlayerSideSnapshot()) {
238                        if (otherFleet.getFaction() != null && otherFleet.getFaction().getCustomBoolean(Factions.CUSTOM_NO_BOUNTY_FOR_DEFEATING)) {
239                                continue;
240                        }
241                        
242                        if (commerceMode) {
243                                if (!market.getFaction().isHostileTo(otherFleet.getFaction()) && 
244                                                !otherFleet.getFaction().isHostileTo(Factions.INDEPENDENT)) continue;
245                                
246                                if (Misc.isTrader(otherFleet)) continue;
247                                if (Factions.INDEPENDENT.equals(otherFleet.getFaction().getId())) continue;
248                        } else {
249                                if (!market.getFaction().isHostileTo(otherFleet.getFaction())) continue;
250                        }
251                        
252                        float bounty = 0;
253                        for (FleetMemberAPI loss : Misc.getSnapshotMembersLost(otherFleet)) {
254                                float mult = Misc.getSizeNum(loss.getHullSpec().getHullSize());
255                                bounty += mult * baseBounty;
256                                fpDestroyed += loss.getFleetPointCost();
257                        }
258                        
259                        payment += (int) (bounty * battle.getPlayerInvolvementFraction());
260                }
261        
262                if (payment > 0) {
263                        Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().getCredits().add(payment);
264                        
265                        float repFP = (int)(fpDestroyed * battle.getPlayerInvolvementFraction());
266                        ReputationAdjustmentResult rep = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
267                                                        new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.SYSTEM_BOUNTY_REWARD, new Float(repFP), null, null, true, false), 
268                                                        market.getFaction().getId());
269                        latestResult = new SystemBountyResult(payment, battle.getPlayerInvolvementFraction(), rep);
270                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(latestResult, false);
271                }
272        }

277        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
278                
279                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
280                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
281                float pad = 3f;
282                float opad = 10f;
283                
284                float initPad = pad;
285                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) initPad = opad;
286                
287                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
288                
289                bullet(info);
290                boolean isUpdate = getListInfoParam() != null;
291                
292                if (isEnding() && isUpdate) {
293                        //info.addPara("Over", initPad);
294                } else {
295                        if (isUpdate && latestResult != null) {
296                                info.addPara("%s received", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(latestResult.payment));
297                                if (Math.round(latestResult.fraction * 100f) < 100f) {
298                                        info.addPara("%s share based on damage dealt", 0f, tc, h, 
299                                                        "" + (int) Math.round(latestResult.fraction * 100f) + "%");
300                                }
301                                CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(latestResult.rep.delta, faction, null, 
302                                                                                                                  null, null, info, tc, isUpdate, 0f);
303                        } else if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) {
304                                info.addPara("%s base reward per frigate", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(baseBounty));
305                                if (!commerceMode) {
306                                        addDays(info, "remaining", duration - elapsedDays, tc);
307                                }
308                        } else {
309                                if (!isEnding()) {
310                                        info.addPara("Faction: " + faction.getDisplayName(), initPad, tc,
311                                                                 faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getDisplayName());
312                                        info.addPara("%s base reward per frigate", 0f, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(baseBounty));
313                                        if (!commerceMode) {
314                                                addDays(info, "remaining", duration - elapsedDays, tc);
315                                        }
316                                }
317                        }
318                }
319                unindent(info);
320        }

364        public void createSmallDescription(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height, 
365                                                                           boolean forMarketConditionTooltip) {
366                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
367                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
368                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
369                float pad = 3f;
370                float opad = 10f;
371
372                //info.addPara(getName(), c, 0f);
373                
374                //info.addSectionHeading(getName(), Alignment.MID, 0f);
375                
376                if (!forMarketConditionTooltip) {
377                        info.addImage(faction.getLogo(), width, 128, opad);
378                }
379
380                String locStr = "near " + market.getName();
381                if (market.getStarSystem() != null) {
382                        locStr = "in or near the " + market.getStarSystem().getNameWithLowercaseType();
383                }
384                
385                if (commerceMode) {
386                        info.addPara("%s commercial concerns " + market.getOnOrAt() + " " + market.getName() + 
387                                        " have banded together and posted a modest but long-term bounty on all "
388                                        + "hostile fleets " + locStr + ".",
389                                        opad, faction.getBaseUIColor(), Misc.ucFirst(faction.getPersonNamePrefix()));
390                        info.addPara("The bounty stipulates that trade fleets are an exception - "
391                                        + "attacking them will not result in a reward, regardless of their faction.", opad);
392                } else {
393                        info.addPara("%s authorities " + market.getOnOrAt() + " " + market.getName() + 
394                                        " have posted a bounty on all hostile fleets " + locStr + ".",
395                                        opad, faction.getBaseUIColor(), Misc.ucFirst(faction.getPersonNamePrefix()));
396                }
397
398                if (isEnding()) {
399                        info.addPara("This bounty is no longer on offer.", opad);
400                        return;
401                }
402                
403//              if (!Global.getSector().getListenerManager().hasListener(this)) {
404//                      Global.getSector().getListenerManager().addListener(this);
405//                      info.addPara("Listener not registered!", opad);
406//              }
407                
408                addBulletPoints(info, ListInfoMode.IN_DESC);
409                
410                if (!commerceMode) {
411                        if (enemyFaction != null) {
412                                info.addPara("Likely triggered by %s activity.",
413                                                opad, enemyFaction.getBaseUIColor(), enemyFaction.getPersonNamePrefix());
414                        }
415                } else {
416                        info.addPara("Triggered by the presence of Commerce on one of your colonies in-system, and by the "
417                                        + "level of hostile activity.", opad);
418                }
419                
420                
421                info.addPara("Payment depends on the number and size of ships destroyed. " +
422                                         "Standing with " + faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + " may also improve.",
423                                         opad);
424//                                       opad, faction.getBaseUIColor(),
425//                                       faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
426                
427                
428                if (!commerceMode) {
429                        String isOrAre = faction.getDisplayNameIsOrAre();
430                        FactionCommissionIntel temp = new FactionCommissionIntel(faction);
431                        List<FactionAPI> hostile = temp.getHostileFactions();
432                        if (hostile.isEmpty()) {
433                                info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle()) + " " + isOrAre + " not currently hostile to any major factions.", 0f);
434                        } else {
435                                info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle()) + " " + isOrAre + " currently hostile to:", opad);
436                                
437                                info.setParaFontDefault();
438                                
439                                info.setBulletedListMode(BaseIntelPlugin.INDENT);
440                                float initPad = pad;
441                                for (FactionAPI other : hostile) {
442                                        info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(other.getDisplayName()), other.getBaseUIColor(), initPad);
443                                        initPad = 0f;
444                                }
445                                info.setBulletedListMode(null);
446                        }
447                }
448                
449                if (latestResult != null) {
450                        //Color color = faction.getBaseUIColor();
451                        //Color dark = faction.getDarkUIColor();
452                        //info.addSectionHeading("Most Recent Reward", color, dark, Alignment.MID, opad);
453                        info.addPara("Most recent bounty:", opad);
454                        bullet(info);
455                        info.addPara("%s received", pad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(latestResult.payment));
456                        if (Math.round(latestResult.fraction * 100f) < 100f) {
457                                info.addPara("%s share based on damage dealt", 0f, tc, h, 
458                                                "" + (int) Math.round(latestResult.fraction * 100f) + "%");
459                        }
460                        CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(latestResult.rep.delta, faction, null, 
461                                                                                                          null, null, info, tc, false, 0f);
462                        unindent(info);
463                }
464
465        }
